comparison.objective: Clean an SC ferrule and latch the connector into an adapter; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ferrule wiping, keyed connector alignment, insertion, and latch engagement versus recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, relocking, and repeated dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Connector cleaned and latched versus two safe carriage stops without bottoming, rebound, overload, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve precise insertion and a retention mechanism, but those generic primitives serve different tested abilities; fibre cleaning/latching does not test calibration. Record lacks specs, cleanliness criteria, latch-force limits, and damage thresholds.
